# Source

Unmodified copy of `tests/draft2020-12` and `remotes` from the
JSON-Schema-Test-Suite at commit
`e82bfdfa59c63cc74175d35fac81bb95e61db24b`, the commit that the JSON-Schema-Test-Suite
submodule of ajv v8.20.0 pins.

The draft2020-12 directory is the published conformance corpus for this
package's 2020-12 dialect. The remotes directory carries the schemas the corpus
references; the 2020-12 entry point registers the ones whose own meta-schema it
publishes.
